title: Free script REALLY  OP
features:
🎯 Combat (Silent Aim Tab)
Silent Aim - Aimlock without moving your camera 

Wallbang - Shoot through walls

Aim Part - Choose between Head, HumanoidRootPart, UpperTorso

FOV Circle - Visual circle that follows your mouse

Rainbow FOV - Rainbow colors for the FOV circle

Adjustable FOV Size - 30 to 500 pixels

🎯 Aimbot Tab
Aimbot - Traditional aimbot (activates with right mouse button)

Team Check - Don't aim at teammates

Wall Check - Checks if a wall is blocking the shot

Sticky Aim - Stays locked on the same target

Aim Parts - Multiple body parts selectable (Head, HumanoidRootPart, UpperTorso, LowerTorso)

Smoothing - 1 to 100 (smoother aim = less noticeable)

FOV Circle - Visual circle for aimbot

Adjustable FOV Size - 30 to 500 pixels

👁️ ESP Tab
ESP Boxes - Boxes around players

ESP Names - Player names above the boxes

ESP Health Bar - Health bar next to the player

ESP Tracers - Lines from bottom center of screen to players

ESP Color - Customizable color for all ESP elements

🎨 Visuals Tab
Fullbright - Makes the entire world bright (no dark areas)

Infinite Zoom - Unlimited zoom in/out with Z (zoom out/see more) and X (zoom in/see less) - FOV from 20 to 120

Crosshair - Custom crosshair in the center of your screen

Noclip - Walk through walls and objects

Instant Interact - No hold duration on proximity prompts (instant E interaction)

👥 Players Tab
Player List - Click on any player to see their info

Player Distance - Shows distance to the selected player

Player Inventory - Shows what items the player has

Spectate Mode - Watch any player (click SPECTATE button)

🍬 Marshmallow Farm Tab
Batch Amount - Set how many bags you want to make

Start Farming - Automatically crafts marshmallow bags

Stop Farming - Stop the farm with button or P key

Status Display - Shows current progress

Automatic Equipment - Auto-equips Water, Sugar Block Bag, Gelatin, and Empty Bag

Auto E-press - Automatically presses E at the cooking station

⚙️ Settings Tab
Close UI - Completely unloads the menu

⌨️ Keybinds
Right Shift - Open/Close menu
Right Mouse Button - Activate Aimbot (when Aimbot is enabled)
P - Stop Marshmallow Farm
